name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oooh, it's been a while~"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ghosts have a lot of free time, yeah? So I figured I'd try reading or something, but nah. One second in and I was already bored."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "That's when she taught me stuff about ghosts. Like 'triggers' and what you shouldn't ask."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "What did you call her again? Ms. Librarian?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ms. Libriariar... Librarbriarar... gah, I keep tripping over it. It's like a tongue twister."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Eh, whatever. Let's get going."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... Oh, there she is."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "She gets triggered if you kick up a fuss—oh, you already know?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I'll do the talking, you can just keep quiet and listen."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yo~"

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Oh? Now this is rare. You even brought Kugayama-san's buddy with you."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Though I see Kugayama-san herself isn't with you?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ah... guess that means she hasn't been here, then."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "...Something seems to have happened. Is it related to that incident?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I think. Shiorin's worried she might've been the culprit all along, so she went off on her own. Probably afraid she'd end up hurting her buddy here."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, we're worried, that's why we're looking for Shiorin together. Oh, and what was it again? Ah, right, we're also looking for proof that Shiorin ain't the culprit."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I'm afraid I'm not quite following. Did something happen that made Kugayama-san think that way?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Yeah, but I don't think there's any real proof or anything. Apparently, some dude who seemed to be the culprit just straight up told her, 'You're the culprit!' or something."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "She came into contact with the culprit?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Looks like it. Someone who looks the part, at least."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "And well... it's kinda half my fault, actually. I'm the one who told her about him."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "So yeah, I figured I'm responsible too, I guess? That's why I'm helping out."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "I see... I think I have a general grasp of the situation now."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "But I'm afraid there's nothing new I can tell you about the incident."

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "If Kugayama-san happens to come here, I'll make sure to keep her from leaving."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "'Kay, thanks~. Bye~"
(Nod in appreciation)

name: Ms. Librarian
message: "Please take care."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Guess she wasn't here. Oh well, it is what it is. Time to switch gears."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh yeah, right. Might as well tell you my trigger too. Just in case."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Y'see, I hate it when people look down on me. Been that way since before I died."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hasn't changed even after I became a ghost. Like, the second I think, 'Oh, this guy's totally looking down on me,' something just snaps."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But hey, you're fine otherwise. Just figured I'd warn you."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Alrighty then, let's hit the next spot."
